item.title: Sacred Puhon Biya at Kamakhya Temple: What is this Lesser Known Ritual
item.description: As thousands visit Kamakhya, an ancient divine marriage unfolds quietly in their midst Amid the winter chill of the Assamese month of Puh (Pousha), the Nilachal Hills in Guwahati quietly comes alive with an ancient ritual that has been observed for centuries and yet remains largely unknown to many. Known as Puhon Biya, the tradition marks the divine wedding of Lord Kameswar and Goddess Kameswari, symbolising the eternal union of Lord Shiva and Goddess Shakti. item.title: 14 Dead as Bus Plunges into Deep Gorge in Himachal’s Sirmaur
item.description: GUWAHATI: At least 14 people lost their lives and several others were injured after a private bus plunged nearly 500 feet into a gorge in Himachal Pradesh’s Sirmaur district on January 9, Friday. The accident occurred near Haripurdhar village, around 95 km from Nahan, when the bus lost control on a narrow mountain road.
